calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_period
LIMIT 30

WITH sales_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1
    AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude web/online store
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id
)
SELECT
  fiscal_year,
  store_id,
  net_sales
FROM sales_by_period
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, store_id

WITH sales_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id
  FROM sales_by_period
  GROUP BY store_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fiscal_year) = 2
),
lfl_sales AS (
  SELECT
    fiscal_year,
    SUM(net_sales) AS total_net_sales
  FROM sales_by_period
  WHERE store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  GROUP BY fiscal_year
)
SELECT
  fiscal_year,
  total_net_sales,
  LAG(total_net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year) AS prior_year_sales,
  ROUND(((total_net_sales - LAG(total_net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year)) / LAG(total_net_sales) OVER (ORDER BY fiscal_year)) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales
ORDER BY fiscal_year

WITH sales_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1
    AND s.store_id < 900
    AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  COALESCE(a.fiscal_year, 'FY2025/26') AS fiscal_year,
  COALESCE(a.store_id, b.store_id) AS store_id,
  a.net_sales AS fy2025_26_sales,
  b.net_sales AS fy2026_27_sales
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM sales_by_period WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
) a
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT * FROM sales_by_period WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
) b ON a.store_id = b.store_id
WHERE a.store_id IS NULL OR b.store_id IS NULL
ORDER BY COALESCE(a.store_id, b.store_id)
